title: Bodybuilding w/ heavy bench
author: TreeGaming Forever
desc:
6x chest
5x triceps
6x biceps
4x side Delt
3x OHP
6x back
*guess other muscle volumes*

Double progression

Don’t expect to progress every week, be okay adding a rep maybe every third week! Muscle takes a long time!

Eat 0.7g-1g of protein per lb of *lean mass*

Adjust volume accordingly to what you want to focus. I wouldn’t exceed 10 sets per muscle if you add more

Change exercises to what you want, but I’d keep a minimum of 6 sets if you want a muscle to grow, that’s just what I do. Obviously it’ll grow with lower volume probably but I like 6 sets.

I have it structured with a 1x a week frequency for some muscles cuz I found it makes my workouts faster, AND it shouldn’t effect my muscle growth since with volume adjusted it doesn’t matter if it’s 1x a week frequency. So 6x chest over 1 day versus 2 doesn’t matter.

ex.note:
First set can be a topset of 5 if you feel like going heavy
Also change the rep range whenever ya get bored

Whatever rep range lets me do a plate lol
Whatever hand placement makes it comfortable
